scope_contract: For an explicit accounting scope, only positively source-supported matches compete when at least one semantically valid candidate matches. Unknown-scope candidates remain in pool/trace and cannot themselves be published. Physically identical renditions and proven same-scope contradictory values remain checked. With no proven match, preserve UNKNOWN. Applies equally to all company names.
format_contract: After identity/period/role/scope is proven independently, enumerate numeric interpretations of an ambiguous source token. A single finer, independently resolved canonical fact can support exactly one interpretation at its printed quantum, using the existing nearest-display-precision policy. No gold, neural answer or arbitrary tolerance; no chains or coarse-to-fine inference.
limits: No automatic repair of PDF unit contradictions, no handwritten source unit. Missing OCR text requires MinerU extraction; preserve originals. Reference values never change to fit outputs.
